objectives.Ridge_OLS: SSE/(2*n) + lambda/2 * sum(w^2), OLS lambda=0 requires full design rank
objectives.OvR_L1_Logistic: mean(logaddexp(0,z)-y_binary*z) + alpha*sum(abs(w)); union support across classes
objectives.intercept: Never penalized. Softmax common intercept shift is nonidentifiable; compare centered intercepts or probabilities/objective/gradient.
objectives.reference_mapping: LR C=1/(n*lambda); L1 Logistic C=1/(n*alpha); Ridge sklearn alpha=n*lambda; LASSO sklearn alpha=alpha

acceptance.class_mapping: Dataset classes ordered explicitly; numeric targets are indices, never continuous values for multiclass sparse selection.
acceptance.scope: Solver-level references on train-standardized buffers, no validation preprocessing or labels fitted. Full nested workflow acceptance remains separate.

rank_deficient_OLS.native_rule: error_rank_deficient; do not silently return the reference minimum-norm solution
